findings.explanation: Only the client can terminate the contract without cause, while you do not have the same right.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement upon ninety (90) days prior written notice to the other party.

findings.quoted_text: EXCEPT FOR CLAIMS UNDER SECTION 9 HEREOF, THE LIABILITY OF A PARTY TO THE OTHER FOR DIRECT DAMAGES SHALL NOT EXCEED FIFTEEN MILLION DOLLARS.
findings.explanation: Claims under Section 9, such as intellectual property indemnification, are excluded from your liability cap and remain completely uncapped.
findings.suggested_change: The liability of a party to the other for direct damages shall not exceed fifteen million dollars, inclusive of any claims under Section 9 hereof.

findings.quoted_text: and the balance within sixty (60) days of the execution of this Agreement.
findings.explanation: Payment is due in 60 days, which is later than the standard 30-day term and creates a cash flow delay for you.
findings.suggested_change: and the balance within thirty (30) days of the execution of this Agreement.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sharing the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to request a couple of minor adjustments before signing. - Regarding the section on liability, claims under Section 9 are currently excluded from the liability cap. I propose changing the relevant clause so that the agreement states: The liability of a party to the other for direct damages shall not exceed fifteen million dollars, inclusive of any claims under Section 9 hereof. - Regarding the payment terms, the balance is currently due in 60 days, which creates a cash flow delay. I propose updating the relevant clause so that the agreement states: and the balance within thirty (30) days of the execution of this Agreement. Please let me know if these changes work for you. Best regards,
